findings.summary: RACER, CONCUR, SDR, Solo.io quota-management, Keel budget envelopes, and AgentBudget were added; two new no-material-change passes follow the last material search.
The bibliography audit is corpus-bound and independently verifies all retained metadata and review status.
R49, R35, and R56 metadata are corrected against their primary records.
Systems-integration novelty was removed after R55 and R56 established gateway reserve-dispatch-reconcile and budget envelopes as prior art.
R55 concurrency wording now distinguishes source-confirmed expiry behavior from a possible concurrent-settlement race that remains an inference pending a faithful test of the pinned code.

Preregistered comparative measurement of risk-utilization, isolation, drift, faulty-event behavior, and local overhead against practical envelopes, adaptive estimators, quantiles, strict reservation, and strong routers.
